So, a lot of you here were former (long-time) redditors. I can imagine a lot of you have contributed to the content on reddit. For instance in r/theinternetisbeautiful there were posts with a collection of the best websites, or on r/documentaries posts with lists of the best documentaries, etc.

Would it be good if we would for instance copy some of those posts to their respective subverses on Voat? So that these subverses have their basics. Like lists of movies, music, books, etc.. Or should we only make new content?

What do you guys think?
Should we copy basic posts from Reddit to their respective subverses to have a minimum content?
There is really no need to do that. Reddit is still there. It is online. If you want to see there content then go there. We can make our own content here.

Reddit is just a content source like anywhere else. If there's a link worth looking at, post it--that's how link posting works. Spoiler alert, every link comes from 'somewhere else'. If it's somebody else's OC text post, then don't bring that over. We don't need to have half of somebody else's conversation.

No. For one, you can't guaruntee they're the same just because they share a name. Secondly, as mindblast says, do you want a copy and past community? All you would end up would be, at least in posts, a replication of Reddit's circlejerks and selectively-picked information. If we're going to have circlejerks and agenda posters, at least let them be our own.

The site won't be any good if all we do is take from others. I think it would be better to post more OC and not just copy from Reddit.

I remember going through those lists on reddit if i needed inspiration for books, websites, movies.. But I don't want to visit Reddit anymore. Guess I start making my own lists and posting them here.. :)

We should build up our 'own' database and such, I'm sure there will be sites and posts which can be found on both Voat and Reddit because that's just how things work, but don't just copy it because there is nothing here yet. Add your own, and let people add their own, and slowly but surely it'll happen.

There's a few issues at play that this article is presenting. I think the first is whether breast feeding should be done in public. Frankly, to me its not an issue. I think people have over-sexualized nudity and I'd be unphased by it. However, what's really at play in the article is whether the initial account is reliable at all...and if I interpret it through my vision of what happened it seems to be there are multiple parties handling things poorly. Finally, there's the whole aspect of internet-shaming. People make mistakes all day long and I continue to find it disturbing how quickly people attempt to assemble others in vitriolic fashion.

I am a woman and find it offensive when mothers think it is perfectly acceptable to just pull out a breast and start feeding in public. Where I know that babies must be feed and that breast feeding is preferred, I also believe these women should show some basic consideration to those around them. Being asked to cover yourself with a cloth or to move to a more private location is no more disrespectful that asking you to close your mouth when you chew. This woman is a bully and everyone down voting the restaurant because she was not allowed to abuse the PAYING patrons are bullies as well. It is time for people to learn that being asked to behave in a considerate and adult manner is not an infringement of their liberties.
